messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: scale_colour_manual using part of scale_colour_brewer
parts:
Hi,

Try this,

library(RColorBrewer)
qplot(x,y, data=data.frame(x=1:9,y=1:9), colour=factor(x),size=I(5)) +
scale_colour_manual(values = c(brewer.pal(8, "Set1"),"black"))

HTH,

baptiste
